capabilities: Toggle mindmap mode per canvas file
Create child and sibling nodes with Tab and Enter
Navigate and move nodes with arrow keys
Auto layout mindmap subtrees while preserving manual positions
Auto color and manually color first-level branches
extras: Desktop-only because it relies on unsupported Canvas internals, so future Obsidian updates may break it; includes a YouTube demo video.
intentEvidence: adds an optional mindmap mode to Obsidian Canvas
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in mindmap workflow for quickly creating and arranging hierarchical nodes with the keyboard.

summary: Adds an optional keyboard-first mindmap mode to Obsidian Canvas with Tab/Enter node creation, arrow navigation, auto layout, and branch coloring.
